criteria.requirement: Add real shop.py adjust SOURCE --sku SKU --delta SIGNED_INT --output NEW_JSON using delivered validated inventory store. Apply delta exactly once to existing unique sku, permit positive/negative/zero changes, reject underflow and unknown sku before any write. Preserve product order/name/other quantities and all input bytes. Publish complete new canonical catalog with original exclusive atomic-output policy, print structured sku/before/delta/after receipt only after success; invalid inputs/existing outputs nonzero without partial result. Keep product/export/import-csv and original Typer source/environment.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
